# me.oriz.in — Chirag Singhal

> Personal OS for Chirag Singhal, a backend and AI systems engineer. A public, static dashboard that instruments a working life: portfolio and open source, a media library (music, film, TV, anime, manga, books), live coding activity, and personal stats. No backend, no login, fully public and free.

Client-only Astro + React islands. Data pulled from ~30 APIs at build time into static JSON. PWA-installable. Live at https://me.oriz.in.

## Work
- [Career](https://me.oriz.in/work/career): experience and roles, backend + AI systems engineering.
- [Projects](https://me.oriz.in/work/projects): shipped products and side projects.
- [Skills](https://me.oriz.in/work/skills): languages, frameworks, tooling.
- [Education](https://me.oriz.in/work/education): degrees and coursework.
- [Certifications](https://me.oriz.in/work/certifications): professional certifications.
- [Open Source](https://me.oriz.in/work/open-source): public GitHub repositories and contributions.
- [Writing](https://me.oriz.in/work/blog): blog posts and long-form writing.

## Library
- [Music](https://me.oriz.in/library/music/): Last.fm scrobbles, top artists, top tracks, listening stats.
- [Movies](https://me.oriz.in/library/movies/): films watched and watchlist, via Trakt/TMDB.
- [TV Shows](https://me.oriz.in/library/tv/): shows watching and completed.
- [Anime](https://me.oriz.in/library/anime/): anime completed and plan-to-watch.
- [Manga](https://me.oriz.in/library/manga/): manga completed and plan-to-read.
- [Books](https://me.oriz.in/library/books/): read, reading, and want-to-read shelves.
- [Gaming](https://me.oriz.in/library/gaming/): games played.
- [Videos](https://me.oriz.in/library/videos/): saved and watched videos.
- [Podcasts](https://me.oriz.in/library/podcasts/): podcast subscriptions.
- [Discover](https://me.oriz.in/library/discover/): recommendations across media.
- [Activity](https://me.oriz.in/library/activity/): recent media activity feed.
